headlines.title: Trump admin taps former JPMorgan Chase exec Matt Zames to advise Social Security agency
headlines.summary: Matt Zames is taking an unpaid position to help his former JPMorgan colleague Frank Bisignano tackle modernization of the SSA, CNBC has learned.

headlines.title: Most Americans aren t anti-vaccine. They re uncertain — and that s a growing public health challenge
headlines.summary: The bigger issue at hand may be that many Americans fall into a large, uncertain middle ground – neither firmly pro-vaccine nor staunchly opposed.

headlines.title: Why some of America s biggest brands are losing ground in China
headlines.summary: Nike, Starbucks and GM have lost ground in China as domestic rivals, geopolitics and changing consumer preferences reshape the market.

headlines.title: New York unseats San Francisco as the top market for tech talent, CBRE reports
headlines.summary: AI-related roles now account for nearly one-third of all tech-talent job listings in the U.S., per the new CBRE report.

headlines.title: California AG tells CNBC that settling Paramount-WBD lawsuit would require robust structural remedies
headlines.summary: California AG Rob Bonta discussed the states' antitrust case to block the Paramount Skydance-Warner Bros. Discovery merger with CNBC's David Faber.

headlines.title: How wealthy families can prepare for aging parents and avoid a succession crisis
headlines.summary: Relatively few wealthy families are addressing the question of when an aging parent should give up control, advisors and lawyers told CNBC.

headlines.title: Where commercial real estate demand is the highest, according to new data
headlines.summary: The National Association of Realtors has released a new index that uses factors in local economies to indicate future demand.

headlines.title: Walmart stock tumbles 9% after outlook disappoints Wall Street
headlines.summary: Walmart is expected to report its fiscal second-quarter earnings on Thursday, offering a read on the consumer and the K-shaped economy.

headlines.title: Hyundai s new flagship vehicle is a large luxury Genesis EV
headlines.summary: The GV90 features a new design direction for Genesis and expands the Hyundai brand's lineup to seven vehicles in the U.S.

headlines.title: Target says its turnaround is picking up steam, with help from a big tariff refund
headlines.summary: Target posted better-than-expected fiscal second-quarter sales and raised its full-year outlook.

headlines.title: Lowe s gives muted outlook as it sees pressure in home improvement spending
headlines.summary: Lowe's reported mixed quarterly results as the retailer said it continued to see pressure in home improvement spending.

headlines.title: Hims & Hers CEO says FTC lawsuit misunderstands how the company works
headlines.summary: Hims & Hers CEO Andrew Dudum spoke to CNBC about the FTC's lawsuit against the company, compounded GLP-1 drugs and AI.

headlines.title: Disney-owned ABC files First Amendment lawsuit against FCC
headlines.summary: Disney's ABC has sued the FCC claiming its investigation and early broadcast licenses renewal are a "retaliatory campaign" due to its programming.

headlines.title: American Airlines to add seatback screens, bigger first class in race to catch up to Delta and United
headlines.summary: American is trying to add more premium seating and passenger perks after falling behind rivals Delta and United.

headlines.title: Home Depot reaffirms guidance amid frozen housing market conditions
headlines.summary: Home Depot reported second fiscal quarter results that beat Wall Street expectations on the top and bottom lines.

headlines.title: Sea Ray parent Brunswick bets on AI navigation and new revenue streams to help stalling boat sales
headlines.summary: Brunswick Corp. CEO David Foulkes told CNBC premium boat sales are staying afloat, while value options are lagging.

headlines.title: Lakers governor Jeanie Buss says siblings cannot sell family’s stake to Bob Iger, Joshua Kushner
headlines.summary: Jeanie Buss's lawyer says she has not agreed to sell the team and that any vote suggesting the Buss family is selling "would be and is void."

headlines.title: Disney s new parks boss outlines investment strategy, with superfans at the fore
headlines.summary: Disney Experiences chief Thomas Mazloum is focused on balancing the needs of its most ardent parkgoers with its less frequent visitors.

headlines.title: Paramount seeks $1.88 billion bond from state AGs to cover costs of WBD merger delay
headlines.summary: Paramount agreed to delay its proposed acquisition of WBD to as late as June 2027 while the state AGs' case heads to trial.

headlines.title: What will TV look like in three years? Media insiders share their predictions
headlines.summary: CNBC asked media insiders what they think the TV market — from pay TV subscribers to sports ratings — will look like in three years.

trend_headline: 월마트 실적 부진과 테슬라 로보택시 승인
summary: 월마트의 실망스러운 실적 전망으로 주가가 급락하며 소비재 및 소매업 섹터의 압박이 부각된 반면, 테슬라는 라스베이거스 로보택시 운행 승인 소식에 힘입어 주가가 반등했습니다. 한편, 트럼프 행정부와 재무부의 채권시장 개입 움직임이 연준의 통화정책과의 엇박자 논란을 낳으며 거시경제 불확실성을 키웠습니다.
